# Cobordism_Classification

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of classifying invertible topological phases by mapping them to cobordism groups, which describe equivalence classes of manifolds under bordism relations. Provides a rigorous mathematical tool to enumerate and distinguish topological phases, enabling systematic exploration of phase space for potential TCC/iNEST computational resources.
